data.name: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
data.detailed_description:
In Bruiseland, the soil drapes thinly over the underworld. Under the watch of avaricious mercenary bands, scavengers pry free their livelihood from subterranean structures.
Left to dry in the desert sun, the swamp devil Fennel has a list of crooked men and the wicked means to bring them low.

Brush Burial: Bruiseland is a distilled immersive sim with compact and complex environments to dissect and dominate. You are a skilled infiltrator, an unmatched fighter, and an even better liar. Eliminate your target by any means.

Features:

  • Densely detailed levels with multiple paths to the objective. Utilize stealth, violence, and deception.

  • Quick and lethal melee combat with an emphasis on positioning, counterattacks, and takedowns. Isolate your enemies and dispatch them with haste. Use their weapons on their allies who still live.

  • Straightforward and legible stealth that rewards speed, and skillful maneuvering.

  • Expressive movement that allows you to climb any structure through careful use of your forked tail.

  • Over a hundred cosmetic items to unlock through gameplay, including those from the previous game.

data.short_description: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

content_descriptors.notes:
Expect some revealing outfits, occasional suggestive (but not explicit) animations, and some infrequent innuendo in conversation, with implicit undercurrents of sadism and masochism.
Non-sexual nudity appears in a couple places.
Violence and death appear wantonly and irreverently across this game. However, it is not terribly gory or graphic in its presentation.
Drugs and alcohol are used frequently without condemnation.
Crimes in the way of burglary, robbery, and murder are not often portrayed as immoral within the context of this game.
